summary: Voice-memo → Whisper → structured entry pipeline verified end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass (parseFromVoice happy path with real MP3, empty/invalid rejection, oversize rejection, bulkSave voice source, unknown source rejection). Frontend: /import loads with Voice as default active tab, 4-tab bar renders correctly, example prompt present, mic-permission-denied path shows voice-error as expected in headless. Regression on /dashboard, /the-press, /quick-entry all load cleanly with no page errors.

minor.issue: Oversize audio (>30MB base64) is rejected by Express body-parser as HTML PayloadTooLargeError (HTTP 413) BEFORE reaching the server-side 25MB check. The zod max(35_000_000) + server 'Audio exceeds 25MB' check are effectively unreachable — express.json({limit:'30mb'}) rejects first with a generic HTML error page rather than a clean tRPC error. Rejection still happens (test passes), but the user would see an unstyled HTML error instead of a graceful message.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Consider raising express.json limit above 33.5mb (base64 overhead of 25MB raw) OR lowering the server-side threshold to align with the 30mb express limit, so the friendly '25MB Whisper limit' error message is actually reachable. Currently users uploading long recordings get a raw Express HTML error page.
critical_code_review_comments: parseFromVoice pipeline is well-structured: Whisper prompt includes winery vocabulary hint (excellent for accuracy on DAP/Brix/MLF/SO2), and graceful fallback returns transcription even if structuring LLM fails so user is never stranded. Good defensive coding.
Empty transcription path returns { entries: [], transcription: '' } with 200 OK — consider whether the UI should show a 'nothing heard' state or if the empty transcription block already handles this.
Body limit '30mb' at server/index.ts is slightly under what 25MB raw audio base64-encodes to (~33.4MB). See minor issue above.
